tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Window and page ground: warm off-white in light, deep slate in dark. ink and ink-muted text sit on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, notices, the nav rail and quiet buttons. ink and ink-muted text sit on it.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: fields, kanban columns, hover on quiet controls. ink and ink-muted text sit on it. Never use it as a mark on surface (1.1:1).

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the command palette and toasts; one step above surface-raised in dark so a panel reads as floating. ink and ink-muted text sit on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers that carry no meaning, on any surface. Never for borders, tracks, dots or text.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Marks that carry meaning: control borders, the timer track and the strip track, tooltip, popover, Kbd and floater edges, segment separators, the scrollbar thumb, BarRow fills, hollow habit dots, the overflow hatch. At least 3:1 on every surface and soft tint.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and timer digits on every surface and soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, helper text and disabled labels; as a mark, paused or shallow only: the paused arc and strip fill and the hollow mode shapes. On every surface and soft tint, at least 4.5:1. Never a neutral bar fill (that is line-strong).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus sessions, Deep work, the primary button fill, the now bar and selected markers; also the focus-time goal bar in Review and the visible word "Today" on today's week head. Never for app usage bars. As text it sits on the surfaces, focus-soft and selection.

tokens.name: focus-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind Focus chips and Deep blocks. ink, ink-muted and focus text sit on it.

tokens.name: on-focus
tokens.usage: Label on the solid focus, focus-hover and focus-pressed fills, and the tick in a checked choice checkbox.

tokens.name: focus-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill; on-focus text sits on it.

tokens.name: focus-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed fill; on-focus text sits on it.

tokens.name: break
tokens.usage: Breaks, completion and the Frog label. As text it sits on the surfaces, break-soft and selection.

tokens.name: break-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind Break chips and blocks. ink, ink-muted and break text sit on it.

tokens.name: on-break
tokens.usage: Label on the solid break, break-hover and break-pressed fills, and the tick in a done checkbox.

tokens.name: break-hover
tokens.usage: Break button hover fill; on-break text sits on it.

tokens.name: break-pressed
tokens.usage: Break button pressed fill; on-break text sits on it.

tokens.name: routine
tokens.usage: Muted sand for routines, habits and Personal blocks. As text it sits on the surfaces and routine-soft. Low chroma on purpose so it never reads as amber.

tokens.name: routine-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind Routine chips and blocks. ink, ink-muted and routine text sit on it.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The only saturated warm: time almost up and WIP limit reached, always with a triangle and a word; also the strip's fill and end triangle when almost up. As text it sits on the surfaces and amber-soft. Never for red-like alerts, estimates or habits.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the Warning chip and the two-minute notice. ink, ink-muted and amber text sit on it.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: One place only: the confirm button in a delete-data dialog. As text it sits on the surfaces and critical-soft.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the critical button; critical text sits on it.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Label on the solid critical fill.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Ground of a selected card, row, command or nav item, always with a word, check or current-page marker. ink, ink-muted, focus and break text sit on it.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline and the today ring on habit dots, on every surface and soft tint. At least 3:1.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the intent prompt, the full-screen exit confirmation and the delete-data dialog. No text sits on it.

tokens.name: clear
tokens.usage: Transparent fill for ghost buttons, hatch gaps and clear dialog backdrops; the ground underneath shows through.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace
families.alt: Lexend, "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: timer-lg
styles.usage: Countdown inside the ring at timer-size. A fluid ring scales its digits with its diameter, never below timer-md. ink on surface.

styles.name: timer-md
styles.usage: Digits in the floating timer and the floor for the strip's digits. ink or ink-muted on surface and surface-raised.

styles.name: timer-sm
styles.usage: Small mono numbers outside the large timers: the compact MenuBarTimer inside the SessionSlot on planning pages, the wall clock inside TimerRing and FullScreenFocus, the NowLine label, calendar hour labels, and durations, estimates and counts in rows ("0h 35m", "Est 3"). Not the macOS menu-bar item, whose title is plain system text. ink or ink-muted on every surface.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: A key name in a Kbd: in tips, tooltips and captions. ink on surface-raised.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: At most once per screen: the Today greeting, the review title. ink on surface.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen and dialog titles. ink on surface or surface-overlay.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section, column and empty-state headings; the large Start label. ink on surface or surface-sunken.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Write the session intent before you start.
styles.usage: Running text, task titles, buttons and fields. ink on every surface and soft tint.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text, notes, disclaimers and the status-row message. ink or ink-muted on every surface and soft tint.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase mode chips, the Frog and Optional labels, block times. Mode colour on its own soft tint.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Kanban counts, rail labels and the ScrollRegion "More below" row. ink-muted on surface, surface-raised or surface-sunken. Hour labels moved to timer-sm.

styles.name: body-alt
styles.sample: Lexend replaces the sans when reading comfort is on.
styles.usage: Replaces body, body-sm, heading and title under the reading-comfort setting. Never replaces timer digits.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; padding around habit dots.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a mode shape and its digits or title; the NowLine dot.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and fields; gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows inside a card; column padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; minimum side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and between kanban columns; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen; cover margins.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Air around the timer ring on Today.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Full-screen margins; the calm, empty edge.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Fields, checkboxes, radio choices, command rows, the menu-bar timer. A 14px checkbox inside a choice chip uses half of it, so it stays square.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, task cards, calendar blocks, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, kanban wells, toasts and the cover slabs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Mode chips, the primary and break buttons, dots.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Task cards, the floating mini timer and toasts. Soft; borders do most of the separating.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette only.

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback on buttons.

tokens.name: duration-calm
tokens.usage: Mode changes and ring steps. The two-minute colour change uses duration-slow. Ease-in-out only.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: The colour fade that marks a time milestone: the ring arc, the chip and the strip fill fading into amber at two minutes, always on easing-calm. The word and the shape switch at once; only colour fades. Instant under reduced motion.

tokens.name: duration-breath
tokens.usage: One breath on the intent prompt: 4s in, 4s out. The only loop in the app. Static under reduced motion.

tokens.name: easing-calm
tokens.usage: The only curve: slow in, slow out. Under reduced motion nothing moves.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of a mode chip. Labels only, never a click target.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of the large Start button and nav rail items; also the round Pause/Resume IconButton, a step flow's footer, an AppRow in regular windows and a Settings index item.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything clicked: buttons, fields, routine rows, radio and checkbox choices, command rows.

tokens.name: hit-floor
tokens.usage: Absolute floor (WCAG 2.2 2.5.8) for compact calendar blocks; also the minimum length of the ScrollRegion thumb (not a required target) and the height of the "More below" row (not a target).

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Width of the nav rail.

tokens.name: window-min-width
tokens.usage: Minimum app window width. The default window stays 900 × 600. Timer surfaces never scroll; list pages scroll only inside their ScrollRegion; nothing is clipped and no control is dropped at any size.

tokens.name: window-min-height
tokens.usage: Minimum app window height. At 360 × 240 Today is the stacked strip and list pages keep a header, a status row and a region of at least 96px.

tokens.name: layout-compact-width
tokens.usage: Below this window width (or below layout-compact-height), a page is compact: no nav rail, a Pages IconButton instead, page pickers replace titles, the Settings index becomes Jump to section.

tokens.name: layout-compact-height
tokens.usage: Below this window height a page is compact; see layout-compact-width. 640 × 480 is the smallest regular window.

tokens.name: layout-strip-height
tokens.usage: Today and the Focus window switch to the strip layout when the content box is wider than twice its height and shorter than this. Switches happen on resize only, never on a tick. The floater never uses it: it is its own composition sized by the floater-* tokens and never changes layout by shape.

tokens.name: layout-ring-min-height
tokens.usage: Below this content height the ring cannot hold its fixed tracks plus timer-min-size: the strip is used at layout-compact-width or wider, the stacked strip below it.

tokens.name: layout-short-height
tokens.usage: Below this window height a step flow's status row takes no space while empty and takes its 44px from the region when a line shows. Never applies to timer surfaces.

tokens.name: layout-tight-height
tokens.usage: Below this visible display height the IntentPrompt's step 2 and typed-reason step drop the breathing circle and the gap goes from space-5 to space-4.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on Today, in reviews and in the Settings content column.

tokens.name: index-width
tokens.usage: The Settings section index.

tokens.name: side-width
tokens.usage: Side lists: the Calendar's Unscheduled tray and the Routines list.

tokens.name: field-width
tokens.usage: A labelled field with its helper (the minute fields); also the ShortcutRecorder's minimum width.

tokens.name: number-width
tokens.usage: A number input before its unit suffix ("min").

tokens.name: column-width
tokens.usage: Widest an expanded kanban column gets; columns are fluid between column-min-width and this. Cards fill it.

tokens.name: column-min-width
tokens.usage: Narrowest an expanded kanban column gets; with two folded strips and space-2 gaps, Doing, Today and Inbox stay open at 900 × 600. Pending the real-font TaskCard check at 200px.

tokens.name: column-strip-width
tokens.usage: A folded kanban column (a strip with chevron, name and count).

tokens.name: hour-gutter
tokens.usage: The hour labels beside day and week lanes (timer-sm, ink-muted).

tokens.name: minute-scale
tokens.usage: Calendar height per minute: a 15-minute block is 30px, a 30-minute block 60px.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Width of dialogs, the capture pad, the command palette, toasts and routine rows; also the AppPicker's width and the cap of the All shortcuts table.

tokens.name: picker-height
tokens.usage: Height of the AppPicker dialog in regular windows; never taller than the window minus space-6.

tokens.name: popover-width
tokens.usage: Width of in-webview popovers: the preset menu and the role menu.

tokens.name: timer-size
tokens.usage: TimerRing diameter at the default 900 × 600 window. The fluid ring sizes to its track between timer-min-size and timer-full-size.

tokens.name: timer-full-size
tokens.usage: Largest TimerRing diameter: the Focus window on a large display.

tokens.name: timer-min-size
tokens.usage: Floor of a fluid TimerRing. The strip's digits never go below timer-md.

tokens.name: floater-width
tokens.usage: Default and minimum width of the floating timer window; holds every state, including "Session ended." with Start and a 1:30:00 Deep Block.

tokens.name: floater-height
tokens.usage: Default height of the floating timer window.

tokens.name: floater-min-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the floating timer window.

tokens.name: floater-max-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the floating timer window.

tokens.name: floater-max-height
tokens.usage: Maximum height of the floating timer window. From 88px (2 × hit-min) the state word gets its own line.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Mode shapes inside chips, cards and blocks; task dots.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Menu-bar shape and ring, the checkbox tick, radio dots, the wellness glyph; also the role glyphs, the alert and info glyphs and the Select chevron.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Nav rail icons, IconButton icons and app icons in AppRow. Line icons at 1.5px stroke.

tokens.name: scrollbar-size
tokens.usage: ScrollRegion's always-drawn scrollbar track. The thumb is inset 2px on each side (6px wide), line-strong, at least hit-floor tall.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Thickness of a BarRow bar in Review and session summaries.

tokens.name: z-rail
tokens.usage: The nav rail above scrolling content.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Toasts, tooltips and in-webview popovers above the rail.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs; native modal dialogs also sit in the top layer.

tokens.name: breakpoint-sm
tokens.usage: Window width from which the sm variant applies (min-width media query).

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: Window width from which the md variant applies (min-width media query).

tokens.name: breakpoint-lg
tokens.usage: Window width from which the lg variant applies (min-width media query).

tokens.name: breakpoint-xl
tokens.usage: Window width from which the xl variant applies (min-width media query).

tokens.name: breakpoint-2xl
tokens.usage: Window width from which the 2xl variant applies (min-width media query).

tokens.name: container-3xs
tokens.usage: Container query width for the @3xs variant and max-w-3xs.

tokens.name: container-2xs
tokens.usage: Container query width for the @2xs variant and max-w-2xs.

tokens.name: container-xs
tokens.usage: Container query width for the @xs variant and max-w-xs.

tokens.name: container-sm
tokens.usage: Container query width for the @sm variant and max-w-sm.

tokens.name: container-md
tokens.usage: Container query width for the @md variant and max-w-md.

tokens.name: container-lg
tokens.usage: Container query width for the @lg variant and max-w-lg.

tokens.name: container-xl
tokens.usage: Container query width for the @xl variant and max-w-xl.

tokens.name: container-2xl
tokens.usage: Container query width for the @2xl variant and max-w-2xl.

tokens.name: container-3xl
tokens.usage: Container query width for the @3xl variant and max-w-3xl.

tokens.name: container-4xl
tokens.usage: Container query width for the @4xl variant and max-w-4xl.

tokens.name: container-5xl
tokens.usage: Container query width for the @5xl variant and max-w-5xl.

tokens.name: container-6xl
tokens.usage: Container query width for the @6xl variant and max-w-6xl.

tokens.name: container-7xl
tokens.usage: Container query width for the @7xl variant and max-w-7xl.

tokens.name: container-start-compact
tokens.usage: StartButton content width below which the pill reads "Start" (compactLabel); the @max-start-compact variant.

tokens.name: container-ring-clock
tokens.usage: Fluid TimerRing width from which the wall clock uses timer-md; the @ring-clock variant.

tokens.name: container-tooltip
tokens.usage: The widest a Tooltip panel gets: 40 characters of its own text, two lines at most (max-w-tooltip).

tokens.name: fluid-gutter
tokens.usage: Side gutter of a page: 16px in narrow windows, growing with the container to 32px.

tokens.name: fluid-section
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections: 24px in narrow windows, growing with the container to 64px.

tokens.name: fluid-stack
tokens.usage: Gap between related blocks: 12px in narrow windows, growing with the container to 24px.
